source_refs.note: 14.16.2 Social Issues: a main subheading of 14.16 Economic, social and political issues, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 319-319.

items: Vulnerable (jaldi nuqsan uthane wale) log, jaise bachche, buzurg aur kam aamdani wale log, air pollution se sab se zyada affected (mutasir) hote hain.
Gandi hawa ka chronic (lagatar) exposure overall quality of life (zindagi kitni achhi hai) kam karta hai; is se social well-being (muashre ki khushhali) aur community ki sehat par asar parta hai.

Severe (bohat zyada) air pollution logon ko gande ilaqe chhor kar behtar hawa wali jagahon par jane (migrate karne) par majboor kar sakti hai, jis se log displaced (be-ghar) hote hain aur naye problems paida hote hain.
